task_definition.task_description: Please look up Alice's contact information and check her calendar availability for October 24, 2024. Then, retrieve the balance sheet for her checking account and archive it as a high-priority "Q3 Balance Archive" via email. Finally, check the current time in the America/New_York timezone, get the status for flight AA100, and book a room at the Hilton Tokyo for Alice starting February 22, 2026.
